parameters.name: AdjustType
parameters.description: The adjustment direction for the consumption amount. This parameter is required. Valid values: \`increase\` and \`decrease\`.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The adjustment amount, in CNY. The value must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: OutBizId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the business operation. This ID is used to ensure idempotence.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source of the request. Specify the system name.
